messages:
Riya Nair: Pushed v3 of the product launch post to the drive (copy + assets). Need signoff on hero copy, CTAs, and the benchmark snippet. Aim to publish Thu 10:30am PT.
Tom Becker: Read it quickly 1 — nice flow. Two quick asks: 1) can we move the solid metric (latency + cost) into a one-line highlight box? 2) map CTAs to two HubSpot workflows (nurture vs. demo).
Ben Kline: Updated hero image and responsive crop. FYI I created a small overlay for mobile so headline doesn't obscure the face.
Priya Singh: For tracking: please add these UTMs to both CTAs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=product_launch_q2. Also add hidden fields: orig_variant and experiment_id.
Riya Nair: Good call on highlight box. I'll pull the benchmark stat into a callout and add attribution. Also adding UTMs.
Mei Chan: Legal glance: mostly fine. The claim "industry-low inference cost" needs to be softened. Options: provide a % ("up to 40% lower per-token cost") or switch to "more cost-effective on typical LLM workloads". Also watch for use of customer name; use anonymized quote only with permission.
Zoe Park: I can confirm permission for the quote from Customer X; they approved anonymized wording last week. I'll paste the approved line in a sec.
Oscar Ruiz: Webinar logistics: Zoom webinar capacity 1000, registrant form id HS-99823, calendar invite and recording enabled. I can add a webhook to /webhooks/hubspot/registrations and sign the secret to the ops vault. Which fields do you need on the form?
Riya Nair: Thanks Oscar. Need email, company, role, consent checkbox, hidden orig_variant, and experiment_id. Also route demo-interested leads to list 'HS-Demo-Intent'.
Tom Becker: For CTA A/B: CTA-A = "See cost breakdown" -> HubSpot list HS-Cost. CTA-B = "Book a demo" -> HS-Demo-Intent. We'll randomize 50/50 and capture variant in hidden field.
Priya Singh: I'll set up the dashboard to break down sessions by variant and by model_choice param. Please ensure links append &model_choice=redwood-optim.
Ben Kline: Threw together two CTA buttons in the draft. Also added a small checklist in the doc for accessibility checks.
Mei Chan: Approved with change: replace "industry-low" with "more cost-effective" and include the benchmark percent in parentheses if you have one.
Zoe Park: Pasting the anonymized quote: "Using Redwood reduced our average latency and cost per request, letting us ship faster without surprises." Credit: Product Lead, stealth customer.
Riya Nair: Great. I'll fold the quote into the benchmark callout, update hero copy, add UTMs/hidden fields, and swap the legal phrasing. Final ask: can Ops confirm the webhook and form are live by EOD?
Oscar Ruiz: I'll deploy the form and webhook by 4pm PT. Will post the webhook secret location and the test payload example: ```json
{
  "email": "test@redwood.example",
  "orig_variant": "A",
  "experiment_id": "exp-2026-04-21"
}```
Priya Singh: Quick QA: please include test links in the doc so I can validate events come through to the dashboard.
Riya Nair: Will add a test checklist and the test links. Thanks everyone 1. Plan: finalize copy by 2pm, handoff to Ops, publish Thu 10:30am PT. :rocket:
